spatial_coverage.coverage: Global coverage of fire danger indices derived from ECMWF weather forecasts and ERA5 reanalysis.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily fire danger indices from historical simulations using ERA5 reanalysis data.

bands.name: fwi
bands.description: Fire Weather Index - overall fire danger rating

bands.name: ffmc
bands.description: Fine Fuel Moisture Code - moisture content of surface litter

bands.name: dmc
bands.description: Duff Moisture Code - moisture content of loosely compacted organic layers

bands.name: dc
bands.description: Drought Code - moisture content of deep compact organic layers

bands.name: isi
bands.description: Initial Spread Index - expected rate of fire spread

data_description.important_note: CEMS (Copernicus Emergency Management Service) Fire Danger Indices provide comprehensive fire risk assessment based on weather forecasts from ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis. The indices quantify various aspects of fire danger including fuel moisture, fire spread potential, and overall fire weather conditions.

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use FWI (Fire Weather Index) as the primary overall fire danger indicator; combine with component indices (FFMC, DMC, DC, ISI, BUI) for detailed fire behavior assessment.

data_description.data_source: Copernicus Emergency Management Service via Google Earth Engine
